layout_strategies.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8, p-12). Containers with borders must have internal padding. Grid items must be direct children.

home_dashboard.grid: Control Room Grid layout. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
home_dashboard.cards: Flat solid surfaces with sharp edges (rounded-none). 1px solid stroke (border-white/5), no soft shadows. Hover brings slight translation (-translate-y-1) and subtle Wine Red border glow.

lab_page.list_layout: Dense row-based list for games instead of full tables. This allows narrative control. Hover state on row: bg-white/5 or bg-[#722F37]/10.
lab_page.priority_game: Col-span-full layout for 'Start here' game, utilizing 'Tracing Beam' inspired border (gold or wine red highlight on the edge) to draw focus.
lab_page.clean_games: Collapsible section using Shadcn Accordion, customized to have no background, just top/bottom subtle borders.

game_review.split_view: 55% left (board), 45% right (coaching panel). Left-align dense text in the panel.
game_review.board_area: Dark monochrome board design. No wooden textures—keep it digital, sleek, and premium. Use Wine Red for last move highlight, Gold for suggested move/coach annotations.
game_review.coaching_panel: Uses customized Shadcn tabs. Solid background, no glassmorphism to ensure data clarity. High contrast metrics in JetBrains Mono.

sidebar.layout: Fixed on desktop, highly constrained grid. Dark luxury feel.
sidebar.active_state: Left border highlight (border-l-2 border-[#CBA135]), bg-white/5, text-white. No full block background colors.
sidebar.play_with_coach_cta: Solid Gold (#CBA135) text-black to stand out as the premium upsell, placed prominently in the sidebar.

component_rules.cards: DO NOT use standard Shadcn Card default styles. Use raw divs or customize extensively: `bg-[#0a0a0a] border border-white/5 rounded-none`. Go cardless/sharp.
component_rules.buttons: Primary buttons: `bg-[#722F37] hover:bg-[#8C3A44] text-white rounded-none`. Premium CTA: `bg-[#CBA135] text-black hover:bg-[#DCC170] rounded-none`. Ghost buttons: `hover:bg-white/5 text-white`.
component_rules.tabs: Override Shadcn tabs. Use `h-auto` to prevent cutoff. Active tab: `border-b-2 border-[#CBA135] text-white rounded-none bg-transparent`. Inactive tab: `text-[#A1A1AA] border-transparent bg-transparent`.
component_rules.lists: Use crisp dividers (`border-b border-white/5`) for all lists.
component_rules.data_display: Use JetBrains Mono for all chess notation (e4, Nf3) and raw numbers/percentages.

accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `play-coach-btn`, `lab-import-btn`, `game-review-next-move`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over backgrounds must meet APCA ratios. Never use `#A1A1AA` text on anything lighter than `#111111`.

avatar_placeholder.description: Professional chess player portrait to be used for user avatar and coach profile pictures.

dashboard_texture_overlay.description: Dark abstract geometric pattern with golden accents, used sparingly with extremely low opacity (e.g., 5%) to texture the background.

animations.interactions: Hover states must transition smoothly: `transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out`.
animations.page_load: Staggered fade-up entrance for Lab game lists and Home dashboard cards.

icons_library.name: lucide-react
icons_library.instructions: Use Lucide React icons with strokeWidth={1} to match the elegant, thin typography of Cormorant Garamond.
